[[File:Babylon 5 CCG logo.png|thumb|Original Babylon 5 Collectible Card Game game logo.]]
The '''Babylon 5 Collectible Card Game''' is based on the television series ''Babylon 5''. Players lead factions on the Council of Races and compete through diplomacy, intrigue and war. The [[TCGMix]] playtest supports two to four players.<ref name="catalog" />

== History ==

Precedence released the ''Premiere'' set in December 1997 and published expansions through ''Crusade'' in 2000.<ref name="b5first" /><ref name="b5date" /><ref name="b5last" /> The March 2000 rulebook credits Ran Ackels, Edi Birsan, Paul W. Brown III, John Hart, David Hewitt, John Myler and Kevin Tewart for game design. It names Brown as producer and separately credits the development team.<ref name="b5rules" /> The rulebook supports up to five players in standard play, with alternate-faction rules for larger games.<ref name="b5rules" />

== Online play ==

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/babylon5/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-babylon-5-collectible-card-game">[https://tcgmix.com/babylon5/ Play Babylon 5 Collectible Card Game], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194107/https://tcgmix.com/babylon5/ Internet Archive].</ref>
